{{Otheruses|Canister}}
'''Anti-personnel canisters''' were [[Flechette/Legends|flechette]] ammunition loads used in [[Flechette launcher/Legends|flechette launchers]] such as the [[FC-1 flechette launcher/Legends|FC-1 flechette launcher]]. They were specifically designed to be used against personnel, although they were not effective against [[Armor/Legends|armor]]. The canisters retailed for a cost of one hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
